import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
BASE='/app/input_files/'
OUT='/tmp/work/'
fin=pd.read_csv(BASE+'fdic_financials_VT_NH_ME_2022_2025.csv')
inst=pd.read_csv(BASE+'fdic_institutions_VT_NH_ME.csv',low_memory=False)
d=fin.copy(); d['Q']=d['REPDTE']
def safe(n,dd): return np.where(dd>0, n/dd, np.nan)
d['EQ_ASSETS']=d['EQV']; d['ROA_R']=d['ROA']; d['ROE_R']=d['ROE']; d['NIM_R']=d['NIMY']
d['RBC']=np.where(d['RBCRWAJ']>0,d['RBCRWAJ'],np.nan)
d['NONACCR_ASSETS']=safe(d['NAASSET'],d['ASSET'])*100
d['NONACCR_LOANS']=safe(d['NAASSET'],d['LNLSGR'])*100
d['NCL_RATIO']=d['NCLNLSR']; d['P3_ASSETS']=safe(d['P3ASSET'],d['ASSET'])*100
d['P9_ASSETS']=safe(d['P9ASSET'],d['ASSET'])*100
d['NCO_LOANS_ANN']=safe(d['NTLNLS'],d['LNLSGR'])*400
d['ALLL_LOANS']=d['LNATRESR']; d['PROV_ASSETS']=d['ELNATRY']
d['LOANS_ASSETS']=safe(d['LNLSGR'],d['ASSET'])*100
d['LOANS_DEP']=safe(d['LNLSGR'],d['DEP'])*100
d['DEP_ASSETS']=safe(d['DEP'],d['ASSET'])*100
d['RE_LOANS']=safe(d['LNRE'],d['LNLSGR'])*100
d['CI_LOANS']=safe(d['LNCI'],d['LNLSGR'])*100
d['CON_LOANS']=safe(d['LNCON'],d['LNLSGR'])*100
d['OTH_LOANS']=np.where(d['LNLSGR']>0,(d['LNLSGR']-d['LNRE']-d['LNCI']-d['LNCON'])/d['LNLSGR']*100,np.nan)
BASEQ=20220331; ENDQ=20250630; qs=sorted(d['Q'].unique())
im=inst.set_index('CERT'); panel_certs=sorted(d['CERT'].unique()); rows=[]
for c in panel_certs:
    sub=d[d.CERT==c]; fq=int(sub.Q.min()); lq=int(sub.Q.max())
    rec=im.loc[c] if c in im.index else None
    ch1=rec['CHANGEC1'] if rec is not None else None
    newc=rec['NEWCERT'] if rec is not None else 0
    eff=rec['EFFDATE'] if rec is not None else None
    denovo=rec['DENOVO'] if rec is not None else None
    esty=rec['ESTYMD'] if rec is not None else None
    if fq==BASEQ and lq==ENDQ: status='Continuing (full panel)'
    elif fq>BASEQ and lq==ENDQ: status='Entrant (joined after base)'
    elif fq==BASEQ and lq<ENDQ: status='Exit (left before end)'
    else: status='Partial'
    reason=''
    if lq<ENDQ and ch1==223: reason=f'Merged into cert {int(newc)} eff {eff}'
    elif fq>BASEQ and denovo==1: reason=f'De novo (est {esty}); first panel report {fq}'
    elif fq>BASEQ: reason=f'First panel report {fq}'
    rows.append(dict(CERT=c,NAME=sub.NAMEFULL.iloc[-1],ST=sub.STALP.iloc[0],
        BKCLASS=rec['BKCLASS'] if rec is not None else None,
        HCR=rec['NAMEHCR'] if rec is not None else None,
        SPECGRP=rec['SPECGRPN'] if rec is not None else None,
        CB=rec['CB'] if rec is not None else None,
        MUTUAL=rec['MUTUAL'] if rec is not None else None,
        FED=rec['FED'] if rec is not None else None,
        REGAGNT=rec['REGAGNT'] if rec is not None else None,
        OFFICES=rec['OFFICES'] if rec is not None else None,
        FIRST_Q=fq,LAST_Q=lq,N_OBS=int(len(sub)),STATUS=status,REASON=reason,
        ASSET_BASE=float(sub[sub.Q==sub.Q.min()].ASSET.iloc[0]),
        ASSET_END=float(sub[sub.Q==sub.Q.max()].ASSET.iloc[0])))
imap=pd.DataFrame(rows)
d.to_pickle(OUT+'tidy.pkl'); imap.to_pickle(OUT+'imap.pkl')
json.dump({'qs':[int(x) for x in qs],'BASE':BASEQ,'END':ENDQ},open(OUT+'meta.json','w'))
print("Panel certs:",len(panel_certs),"Quarters:",len(qs))
print("\nStatus counts:"); print(imap.STATUS.value_counts().to_string())
print("\nEntrants/exits:")
print(imap[imap.STATUS!='Continuing (full panel)'][['CERT','NAME','ST','FIRST_Q','LAST_Q','STATUS','REASON']].to_string(index=False))
print("\nState x BKCLASS:"); print(pd.crosstab(imap.ST,imap.BKCLASS).to_string())
print("\nSpecialty groups:"); print(imap.SPECGRP.value_counts().to_string())
print("\nCommunity bank flag:",imap.CB.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())

17	      nonaccr_loans=df.NAASSET.sum()/L*100 if L>0 else np.nan,

30	    )

33	    A=df.ASSET.sum(); L=df.LNLSGR.sum()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, pickle
d=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/work/tidy.pkl'); imap=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/work/imap.pkl')
meta=json.load(open('/tmp/work/meta.json')); BASEQ=meta['BASE']; ENDQ=meta['END']; QS=meta['qs']
d=d.sort_values(['CERT','Q']).reset_index(drop=True)
num=['ASSET','DEP','EQ','LNLSGR','LNRE','LNCI','LNCON','NAASSET','NTLNLS','P3ASSET','P9ASSET']

# ---------- PORTFOLIO QUARTERLY TRENDS (reported basis: all banks present each quarter) ----------
def port_agg(df):
    A=df.ASSET.sum(); L=df.LNLSGR.sum(); D=df.DEP.sum(); E=df.EQ.sum()
    nz=df[df.RBCRWAJ>0]
    return dict(
      n=len(df), assets=A, deposits=D, equity=E, loans=L,
      roa_w=np.average(df.ROA_R,weights=df.ASSET), roa_med=df.ROA_R.median(),
      roe_w=np.average(df.ROE_R,weights=df.ASSET),
      nim_w=np.average(df.NIMY,weights=df.ASSET),
      nonaccr_assets=df.NAASSET.sum()/A*100,
      nonaccr_loans=df.NAASSET.sum()/L*100 if L>0 else np.nan,
      ncl_ratio=df.NCLNLSR.sum(),   # placeholder replaced below
      nco_loans_ann=df.NTLNLS.sum()/L*400 if L>0 else np.nan,
      alll_loans=df.LNATRESR.sum(),
      eq_assets=E/A*100,
      rbc_w=np.average(nz.RBCRWAJ,weights=nz.ASSET) if len(nz) else np.nan,
      rbc_n=len(nz), rbc_cov=nz.ASSET.sum()/A*100,
      loans_assets=L/A*100, loans_dep=L/D*100 if D>0 else np.nan,
      re_mix=df.LNRE.sum()/L*100 if L>0 else np.nan,
      ci_mix=df.LNCI.sum()/L*100 if L>0 else np.nan,
      con_mix=df.LNCON.sum()/L*100 if L>0 else np.nan,
      prov_assets_w=np.average(df.ELNATRY,weights=df.ASSET),
      p3_assets=df.P3ASSET.sum()/A*100, p9_assets=df.P9ASSET.sum()/A*100,
    )
# ncl & alll weighted properly
def port_full(df):
    A=df.ASSET.sum(); L=df.LNLSGR.sum()
    r=port_agg(df)
    r['ncl_ratio']=df.NAASSET.sum()+df.P9ASSET.sum()
    r['ncl_ratio']= (df.NAASSET.sum()+df.P9ASSET.sum())/L*100 if L>0 else np.nan
    r['alll_loans']=np.nan if L==0 else df.LNATRESR.mul(df.LNLSGR).sum()/L
    return r
trends=pd.DataFrame([dict(Q=q, **port_full(d[d.Q==q])) for q in QS]).set_index('Q')
trends.to_pickle('/tmp/work/trends.pkl')
print("=== PORTFOLIO TRENDS (reported basis) ===")
cols=['n','assets','roa_w','nonaccr_assets','nco_loans_ann','eq_assets','rbc_w','rbc_n','rbc_cov','nim_w','loans_assets','loans_dep','ncl_ratio','alll_loans']
print(trends[cols].round(3).to_string())

# ---------- CONSTANT-PERIMETER (49 continuing) trends ----------
cont=set(imap[imap.STATUS.str.startswith('Continuing')].CERT)
dc=d[d.CERT.isin(cont)]
cp=pd.DataFrame([dict(Q=q,**port_full(dc[dc.Q==q])) for q in QS]).set_index('Q')
cp.to_pickle('/tmp/work/cp.pkl')
print("\n=== CONSTANT-PERIMETER (49 continuing) key metrics ===")
print(cp[['n','assets','roa_w','nonaccr_assets','nco_loans_ann','eq_assets','rbc_w','rbc_cov','nim_w','loans_assets']].round(3).to_string())

# ---------- HEADLINE NUMBERS (exec summary) ----------
def snap(q): 
    df=d[d.Q==q]; A=df.ASSET.sum(); L=df.LNLSGR.sum(); nz=df[df.RBCRWAJ>0]
    return dict(
      roa=float(np.average(df.ROA_R,weights=df.ASSET)),
      roe=float(np.average(df.ROE_R,weights=df.ASSET)),
      nonaccr_assets=float(df.NAASSET.sum()/A*100),
      nonaccr_loans=float(df.NAASSET.sum()/L*100),
      nco_loans_ann=float(df.NTLNLS.sum()/L*400),
      eq_assets=float(df.EQ.sum()/A*100),
      rbc_w=float(np.average(nz.RBCRWAJ,weights=nz.ASSET)), rbc_n=int(len(nz)),
      rbc_cov=float(nz.ASSET.sum()/A*100),
      nim=float(np.average(df.NIMY,weights=df.ASSET)),
      assets=float(A), loans_assets=float(L/A*100), loans_dep=float(L/df.DEP.sum()*100),
      n=int(len(df)))
H={'BASE':snap(BASEQ),'END':snap(ENDQ),'BASEQ':BASEQ,'ENDQ':ENDQ}
# constant perimeter headline
dfc=dc[dc.Q==ENDQ]; Ac=dfc.ASSET.sum(); Lc=dfc.LNLSGR.sum(); nzc=dfc[dfc.RBCRWAJ>0]
dfb=dc[dc.Q==BASEQ]; Ab=dfb.ASSET.sum(); Lb=dfb.LNLSGR.sum(); nzb=dfb[dfb.RBCRWAJ>0]
H['CP_END']=dict(roa=float(np.average(dfc.ROA_R,weights=dfc.ASSET)),
  nonaccr_assets=float(dfc.NAASSET.sum()/Ac*100),
  nco_loans_ann=float(dfc.NTLNLS.sum()/Lc*400),
  eq_assets=float(dfc.EQ.sum()/Ac*100),
  rbc_w=float(np.average(nzc.RBCRWAJ,weights=nzc.ASSET)), rbc_n=int(len(nzc)),rbc_cov=float(nzc.ASSET.sum()/Ac*100))
H['CP_BASE']=dict(roa=float(np.average(dfb.ROA_R,weights=dfb.ASSET)),
  nonaccr_assets=float(dfb.NAASSET.sum()/Ab*100),
  nco_loans_ann=float(dfb.NTLNLS.sum()/Lb*400),
  eq_assets=float(dfb.EQ.sum()/Ab*100),
  rbc_w=float(np.average(nzb.RBCRWAJ,weights=nzb.ASSET)), rbc_n=int(len(nzb)),rbc_cov=float(nzb.ASSET.sum()/Ab*100))
json.dump(H,open('/tmp/work/headline.json','w'),indent=1)
print("\n=== HEADLINE ==="); print(json.dumps(H,indent=1))

BASEQ=20220331; ENDQ=20250630
cont=set(imap[imap.STATUS.str.startswith('Continuing')].CERT)

def shiftshare(num_col, wgt_col, t0=BASEQ, t1=ENDQ, scale=1.0, universe=None):
    dd=d if universe is None else d[d.CERT.isin(universe)]
    a=dd[dd.Q==t0].set_index('CERT'); b=dd[dd.Q==t1].set_index('CERT')
    C=[i for i in a.index if i in b.index]; X=[i for i in a.index if i not in b.index]; N=[i for i in b.index if i not in a.index]
    S0=a[wgt_col].sum(); S1=b[wgt_col].sum()
    R0=a[num_col].sum()/S0*scale; R1=b[num_col].sum()/S1*scale
    s0=a[wgt_col]/S0; s1=b[wgt_col]/S1
    r0=a[num_col]/a[wgt_col].replace(0,np.nan)*scale; r1=b[num_col]/b[wgt_col].replace(0,np.nan)*scale
    perf=float(sum(s0[i]*(r1[i]-r0[i]) for i in C if pd.notna(r0[i]) and pd.notna(r1[i])))
    wgt=float(sum((s1[i]-s0[i])*r1[i] for i in C if pd.notna(r1[i])))
    entry=float(sum(s1[i]*r1[i] for i in N if pd.notna(r1[i])))
    exit_=float(-sum(s0[i]*r0[i] for i in X if pd.notna(r0[i])))
    return dict(level_t0=float(R0),level_t1=float(R1),delta=float(R1-R0),
      continuing_perf=perf,continuing_weight=wgt,continuing_total=perf+wgt,
      entry=entry,exit=exit_,n_cont=len(C),n_exit=len(X),n_entry=len(N))

# num cols in raw units; for ratio metrics num = ratio*wgt
d['ROA_NUM']=d['ROA_R']/100*d['ASSET']; d['NIM_NUM']=d['NIMY']/100*d['ASSET']
d['NCO_NUM']=d['NTLNLS']*4; d['NCL_NUM']=d['NAASSET']+d['P9ASSET']
d.to_pickle('/tmp/work/tidy.pkl')
res={}
res['ROA asset-weighted %']=shiftshare('ROA_NUM','ASSET',scale=100)
res['NIM asset-weighted %']=shiftshare('NIM_NUM','ASSET',scale=100)
res['Nonaccrual/Assets %']=shiftshare('NAASSET','ASSET',scale=100)
res['NCL (nonaccrual+90+)/Loans %']=shiftshare('NCL_NUM','LNLSGR',scale=100)
res['Net charge-offs/Loans (ann) %']=shiftshare('NCO_NUM','LNLSGR',scale=100)
res['Equity/Assets %']=shiftshare('EQ','ASSET',scale=100)
res['Loans/Assets %']=shiftshare('LNLSGR','ASSET',scale=100)
res['Loans/Deposits %']=shiftshare('LNLSGR','DEP',scale=100)
json.dump(res,open('/tmp/work/decomp.json','w'),indent=1)
print("=== SHIFT-SHARE DECOMPOSITION (reported basis, t0=2022Q1 -> t1=2025Q2) ===")
for k,v in res.items():
    print(f"\n{k}")
    print(f"  level t0={v['level_t0']:.4f}  t1={v['level_t1']:.4f}  Δ={v['delta']:+.4f}")
    print(f"  continuing: perf={v['continuing_perf']:+.4f}  weight/mix={v['continuing_weight']:+.4f}  (total={v['continuing_total']:+.4f})")
    print(f"  entry={v['entry']:+.4f}  exit={v['exit']:+.4f}")
    share_cont = v['continuing_total']/v['delta']*100 if abs(v['delta'])>1e-9 else np.nan
    print(f"  continuing share of Δ = {share_cont:.1f}%  | nC={v['n_cont']} nX={v['n_exit']} nN={v['n_entry']}")

# constant-perimeter (49 continuing only) decomposition -> isolates perf vs within-cohort weight

cp['Equity/Assets']=shiftshare('EQ','ASSET',scale=100,universe=cont)
cp['Loans/Assets']=shiftshare('LNLSGR','ASSET',scale=100,universe=cont)
json.dump(cp,open('/tmp/work/decomp_cp.json','w'),indent=1)
for k,v in cp.items():

d=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/work/tidy.pkl'); imap=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/work/imap.pkl').set_index('CERT')
pb=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/work/perbank.pkl').set_index('CERT')
BASEQ=20220331; ENDQ=20250630; QS=json.load(open('/tmp/work/meta.json'))['qs']

# ---- additional derived: ALLL coverage of nonaccrual, ALLL dollars, NCL slope, quarterly consistency ----
d=d.sort_values(['CERT','Q'])
d['ALLL_DOLLARS']=d['LNATRESR']/100*d['LNLSGR']
d['NA_COVER']=np.where(d['NAASSET']>0, d['ALLL_DOLLARS']/d['NAASSET'], np.nan)  # ALLL / nonaccrual
d['NCL_TREND']=[None]*len(d)
# rolling 4Q change in NCL_RATIO and nonaccrual for trend slope
d['NCL_CHG_4Q']=d.groupby('CERT')['NCL_RATIO'].diff(4)
d['NA_CHG_4Q']=d.groupby('CERT')['NONACCR_ASSETS'].diff(4)
d['ROA_CHG_4Q']=d.groupby('CERT')['ROA_R'].diff(4)
d['EQ_CHG_4Q']=d.groupby('CERT')['EQ_ASSETS'].diff(4)
d['ASSET_CHG_4Q']=d.groupby('CERT')['ASSET'].pct_change(4)*100
d.to_pickle('/tmp/work/tidy.pkl')

# percentile helper within END-Q continuing cohort (reporters only)
cont=imap[imap.STATUS.str.startswith('Continuing')].index
end=d[(d.Q==ENDQ)&(d.CERT.isin(cont))].set_index('CERT')

def pct_rank(series, higher_is_worse=True):
    """percentile 0-100 among non-null; higher_is_worse=True -> worse gets higher pct"""
    s=series.dropna()
    if len(s)==0: return series*0+np.nan
    r=s.rank(pct=True)*100
    if not higher_is_worse: r=100-r
    return r

# build END-Q table with ranks
t=end.copy()
t['R_NA_LOANS']=pct_rank(t['NONACCR_LOANS'],True)      # worse=higher nonaccrual
t['R_NCL']=pct_rank(t['NCL_RATIO'],True)
t['R_NCO']=pct_rank(t['NCO_LOANS_ANN'],True)
t['R_ALLL_LOW']=pct_rank(t['ALLL_LOANS'],False)         # worse=low allowance
t['R_ROA_LOW']=pct_rank(t['ROA_R'],False)               # worse=low ROA
t['R_ROE_LOW']=pct_rank(t['ROE_R'],False)
t['R_EQ_LOW']=pct_rank(t['EQ_ASSETS'],False)
t['R_RBC_LOW']=pct_rank(t['RBC'],False)
t['R_LD_HIGH']=pct_rank(t['LOANS_DEP'],True)            # worse=high loans/deposits
t['R_GROWTH_HIGH']=pct_rank(t['ASSET_CHG_4Q'],True)

# deterioration ranks (change over full window base->end)
chg=pb.reindex(t.index)
t['D_ROA']=pct_rank(chg['ROA_R_chg'],False)             # worse = more negative change
t['D_NA']=pct_rank(chg['NONACCR_ASSETS_chg'],True)      # worse = bigger increase
t['D_NCL']=pct_rank(chg['NCL_RATIO_chg'],True)
t['D_EQ']=pct_rank(chg['EQ_ASSETS_chg'],False)

# composite scores (0-100, higher = more concerning)
t['S_CREDIT']=t[['R_NA_LOANS','R_NCL','R_NCO','R_ALLL_LOW']].mean(axis=1)
t['S_CREDIT_TREND']=t[['D_NA','D_NCL']].mean(axis=1)
t['S_CAPITAL']=t[['R_EQ_LOW','R_RBC_LOW']].mean(axis=1)
t['S_EARNINGS']=t[['R_ROA_LOW','R_ROE_LOW']].mean(axis=1)
t['S_EARNINGS_TREND']=t['D_ROA']
t['S_FUNDING']=t[['R_LD_HIGH']].mean(axis=1)
# weighted priority score: credit level 30, credit trend 20, capital 20, earnings 15, earnings trend 10, funding 5
t['PRIORITY']=(0.30*t['S_CREDIT']+0.20*t['S_CREDIT_TREND']+0.20*t['S_CAPITAL']
              +0.15*t['S_EARNINGS']+0.10*t['S_EARNINGS_TREND']+0.05*t['S_FUNDING'])
# materiality overlay: asset share of END-Q continuing cohort
A=t['ASSET'].sum(); t['ASSET_SHARE']=t['ASSET']/A*100
t['RISK_CONTRIB']=t['PRIORITY']*np.log1p(t['ASSET_SHARE'])
t[['NAMEFULL','STALP','ASSET','ASSET_SHARE','S_CREDIT','S_CREDIT_TREND','S_CAPITAL','S_EARNINGS','S_EARNINGS_TREND','S_FUNDING','PRIORITY','RISK_CONTRIB','RBC','EQ_ASSETS','NONACCR_LOANS','NCL_RATIO','NCO_LOANS_ANN','ALLL_LOANS','ROA_R','ROE_R','LOANS_DEP']].to_pickle('/tmp/work/score.pkl')

pd.set_option('display.width',300)
print("=== PRIORITY SCORE (higher = more concerning) — continuing cohort, 2025Q2 ===")
show=t.sort_values('PRIORITY',ascending=False)[['NAMEFULL','STALP','ASSET','ASSET_SHARE','S_CREDIT','S_CAPITAL','S_EARNINGS','PRIORITY','RISK_CONTRIB']].head(18)
print(show.round(2).to_string())
print("\n=== RISK CONTRIBUTION (priority x log scale) — top 15 ===")
print(t.sort_values('RISK_CONTRIB',ascending=False)[['NAMEFULL','STALP','ASSET_SHARE','PRIORITY','RISK_CONTRIB']].head(15).round(2).to_string())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
d=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/work/tidy.pkl'); imap=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/work/imap.pkl').set_index('CERT')
BASEQ=20220331; ENDQ=20250630
a=d[d.Q==BASEQ].set_index('CERT'); b=d[d.Q==ENDQ].set_index('CERT')
allc=sorted(set(a.index)|set(b.index))
metrics=['ASSET','ROA_R','ROE_R','NIMY','NONACCR_ASSETS','NONACCR_LOANS','NCO_LOANS_ANN','NCL_RATIO',
 'ALLL_LOANS','PROV_ASSETS','EQ_ASSETS','RBC','LOANS_ASSETS','LOANS_DEP','DEP_ASSETS','RE_LOANS','CI_LOANS','CON_LOANS','OTH_LOANS','P3_ASSETS','P9_ASSETS']
rows=[]
for c in allc:
    ra=a.loc[c] if c in a.index else None
    rb=b.loc[c] if c in b.index else None
    ref=rb if rb is not None else ra
    rec=dict(CERT=c,NAME=imap.loc[c,'NAME'],ST=imap.loc[c,'ST'],BKCLASS=imap.loc[c,'BKCLASS'],
             SPECGRP=imap.loc[c,'SPECGRP'],STATUS=imap.loc[c,'STATUS'],
             ASSET_END=float(rb.ASSET) if rb is not None else np.nan,
             ASSET_BASE=float(ra.ASSET) if ra is not None else np.nan)
    for m in metrics:
        v0=float(ra[m]) if (ra is not None and pd.notna(ra[m])) else np.nan
        v1=float(rb[m]) if (rb is not None and pd.notna(rb[m])) else np.nan
        rec[m+'_0']=v0; rec[m+'_1']=v1; rec[m+'_chg']=(v1-v0) if (pd.notna(v0) and pd.notna(v1)) else np.nan
    # CAGR assets (years between base & end; use actual observation span)
    if ra is not None and rb is not None:
        yrs=(2025.5-2022.25)
        rec['ASSET_CAGR']=(rb.ASSET/ra.ASSET)**(1/yrs)-1
    else: rec['ASSET_CAGR']=np.nan
    rows.append(rec)
pb=pd.DataFrame(rows)
# median-based peer benchmarks at END among all reporters
def med(col): return pb[col+'_1'].median()
bench={m:med(m) for m in metrics}
# z-like: deviation from peer median at end (in pp or %)
for m in metrics:
    pb[m+'_devmed']=pb[m+'_1']-bench[m]
pb.to_pickle('/tmp/work/perbank.pkl')
pd.set_option('display.width',260)
print("=== END-Q (2025Q2) peer medians ===")
for m in ['ASSET','ROA_R','ROE_R','NIMY','NONACCR_ASSETS','NCO_LOANS_ANN','NCL_RATIO','ALLL_LOANS','EQ_ASSETS','LOANS_ASSETS','LOANS_DEP','RE_LOANS','CI_LOANS','CON_LOANS']:
    print(f"  {m:18s} median={bench[m]:9.3f}")

print("\n=== Biggest ROA decliners (continuing banks, base->end) ===")
cc=pb[pb.STATUS.str.startswith('Continuing')].copy()
print(cc.sort_values('ROA_R_chg')[['CERT','NAME','ST','ASSET_END','ROA_R_0','ROA_R_1','ROA_R_chg','NONACCR_ASSETS_0','NONACCR_ASSETS_1','NCL_RATIO_1','ALLL_LOANS_1','EQ_ASSETS_1','RBC_1']].head(12).round(3).to_string(index=False))

print("\n=== Highest nonaccrual & NCL at END ===")

print("\n=== Lowest RBC (capital) at END, among reporters ===")
print(cc[cc.RBC_1.notna()].sort_values('RBC_1')[['CERT','NAME','ST','ASSET_END','RBC_0','RBC_1','EQ_ASSETS_1','LOANS_DEP_1']].head(12).round(3).to_string(index=False))

11	    r0=a[num_col]/a[wgt_col].replace(0,np.nan)*scale; r1=b[num_col]/b[wgt_col].replace(0,np.nan)*scale
12	    perf=float(sum(s0[i]*(r1[i]-r0[i]) for i in C if pd.notna(r0[i]) and pd.notna(r1[i])))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
d=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/work/tidy.pkl'); imap=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/work/imap.pkl').set_index('CERT')
cont=set(imap[imap.STATUS.str.startswith('Continuing')].index)

def shiftshare(num_col,wgt_col,t0,t1,scale=1.0,universe=None):
    dd=d if universe is None else d[d.CERT.isin(universe)]
    a=dd[dd.Q==t0].set_index('CERT'); b=dd[dd.Q==t1].set_index('CERT')
    C=[i for i in a.index if i in b.index]; X=[i for i in a.index if i not in b.index]; N=[i for i in b.index if i not in a.index]
    S0=a[wgt_col].sum(); S1=b[wgt_col].sum(); R0=a[num_col].sum()/S0*scale; R1=b[num_col].sum()/S1*scale
    s0=a[wgt_col]/S0; s1=b[wgt_col]/S1
    r0=a[num_col]/a[wgt_col].replace(0,np.nan)*scale; r1=b[num_col]/b[wgt_col].replace(0,np.nan)*scale
    perf=float(sum(s0[i]*(r1[i]-r0[i]) for i in C if pd.notna(r0[i]) and pd.notna(r1[i])))
    wgt=float(sum((s1[i]-s0[i])*r1[i] for i in C if pd.notna(r1[i])))
    entry=float(sum(s1[i]*r1[i] for i in N if pd.notna(r1[i]))); exit_=float(-sum(s0[i]*r0[i] for i in X if pd.notna(r0[i])))
    return dict(t0=float(R0),t1=float(R1),delta=float(R1-R0),cont_perf=perf,cont_wgt=wgt,cont_total=perf+wgt,
      entry=entry,exit=exit_,nC=len(C),nX=len(X),nN=len(N),
      pct_perf=(perf/(R1-R0)*100 if abs(R1-R0)>1e-12 else np.nan))

d['ROA_NUM']=d['ROA_R']/100*d['ASSET']; d['NIM_NUM']=d['NIMY']/100*d['ASSET']; d['NCO_NUM']=d['NTLNLS']*4
d['NCL_NUM']=d['NAASSET']+d['P9ASSET']
d.to_pickle('/tmp/work/tidy.pkl')
specs=[('ROA (asset-wtd) %','ROA_NUM','ASSET',100),('NIM (asset-wtd) %','NIM_NUM','ASSET',100),
 ('Nonaccrual/Assets %','NAASSET','ASSET',100),('NCL (nonaccrual+90+)/Loans %','NCL_NUM','LNLSGR',100),
 ('NCO/Loans (ann) %','NCO_NUM','LNLSGR',100),('Equity/Assets %','EQ','ASSET',100),
 ('Loans/Assets %','LNLSGR','ASSET',100),('Loans/Deposits %','LNLSGR','DEP',100)]
out={}
for win,(t0,t1) in {'A_22Q1_25Q2':(20220331,20250630),'B_22Q2_25Q2':(20220630,20250630)}.items():
    out[win]={lab:shiftshare(nc,wc,t0,t1,sc) for lab,nc,wc,sc in specs}
json.dump(out,open('/tmp/work/decomp_windows.json','w'),indent=1)
for win in out:
    print(f"\n===== WINDOW {win} =====")
    for lab,v in out[win].items():
        print(f"{lab:34s} t0={v['t0']:8.3f} t1={v['t1']:8.3f} Δ={v['delta']:+8.3f} | perf={v['cont_perf']:+7.3f} wgt={v['cont_wgt']:+7.3f} entry={v['entry']:+6.3f} exit={v['exit']:+6.3f} | perf%Δ={v['pct_perf']:6.0f}%")

d=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/work/tidy.pkl'); imap=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/work/imap.pkl').set_index('CERT')

def agg(g):
    A=g.ASSET.sum(); L=g.LNLSGR.sum()

      'roa_w':np.average(g.ROA_R,weights=g.ASSET),'nim_w':np.average(g.NIMY,weights=g.ASSET),
      'nonaccr_assets':g.NAASSET.sum()/A*100,'ncl_loans':(g.NAASSET.sum()+g.P9ASSET.sum())/L*100,
      'nco_ann':g.NTLNLS.sum()/L*400,'eq_assets':g.EQ.sum()/A*100,
      'alll_loans':(g.LNATRESR*g.LNLSGR).sum()/L,'loans_assets':L/A*100,'loans_dep':L/g.DEP.sum()*100,
      're_mix':g.LNRE.sum()/L*100,'ci_mix':g.LNCI.sum()/L*100})

# FULL-YEAR (Q4) earnings trend, continuing cohort

===== OCC p33 =====
As of May 17, 2012, this guidance applies to federal savings associations in addition to national banks.*
Accounting Issues
Accounting issues are intertwined with credit risk ratings, particularly at the
classified level where the credit risk rating often dictates the accounting
treatment. A brief discussion of accounting issues follows. For more detailed
discussion of these topics refer to the OCC’s “Bank Accounting Advisory
Series” publications, Consolidated Reports of Condition and Income (call
report) instructions, and Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB)
statements.
Rebooking Charged-off Credit
In 1997, the instructions to the call report were brought into compliance with
generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) and the practice of
rebooking charged-off loans was disallowed. Under GAAP, when a bank
charges off a loan or lease in part or full, the bank establishes a new cost
basis. Once the loan’s cost basis has been decreased, it cannot be increased
later. For additional guidance concerning rebooking charged-off assets, refer
to FASB 114, “Accounting by Creditors for Impairment of a Loan,” and call
report instructions.
Nonaccrual Status (Updated June 26, 2017)
A loan that is on nonaccrual or about to be placed on nonaccrual has severe
problems such that the full collection of interest and principal is highly
questionable. Nonaccrual loans will almost always be classified.
Banks should follow the Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council’s
“Instructions for Preparation of Consolidated Reports of Condition and
Income” (call report instructions) when determining the accrual status for
commercial and consumer loans. As a general rule, banks shall not accrue
interest, amortize deferred net loan fees or costs, or accrete discount on any
asset if
• the asset is maintained on a cash basis because of deterioration in the
financial condition of the borrower,
• payment in full of principal or interest is not expected, or

• principal or interest has been in default for a period of 90 days or more
unless the asset is both well secured and in the process of collection.4
The call report instructions provide one exception to the general rule for
commercial loans:5
Purchased credit-impaired loans need not be placed in nonaccrual
status when the criteria for accrual of income under the interest
method are met, regardless of whether the loans had been maintained
in nonaccrual status by the seller.6
The call report instructions provide two exceptions to the general rule for
consumer loans:7
1. Consumer loans and loans secured by a one- to four-family residential
property need not be placed in nonaccrual status when principal or
interest is due and unpaid for 90 days or more. Nevertheless, consumer
and one- to four-family residential property loans should be subject to
other alternative methods of evaluation to assure that the bank’s net
income is not materially overstated. To the extent that the bank has
elected to carry a consumer or one- to four-family residential property loan
in nonaccrual status on its books, the loan must be reported as nonaccrual
in the bank’s call report.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Build regional_bank_risk_model.xlsx from /tmp/work artifacts

from openpyxl import Workbook

W = '/tmp/work/'

QS = meta['qs']; BASEQ = meta['BASE']; ENDQ = meta['END']
cont = set(imap[imap.STATUS.str.startswith('Continuing')].CERT)

wb = Workbook()
HDR_FILL = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='1F4E79')

TITLE_FONT = Font(bold=True, size=13, color='1F4E79')
SUB_FONT = Font(bold=True, size=11, color='1F4E79')
NOTE_FONT = Font(italic=True, size=9, color='555555')
TIER1_FILL = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='FCE4EC')
TIER2_FILL = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='FFF3E0')
WATCH_FILL = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='FFFDE7')
thin = Side(style='thin', color='BBBBBB')
BORDER = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)

def q_label(q):
    return f"{q//10000}Q{(q%10000)//100:02d}"

def write_df(ws, df, start_row=1, start_col=1, num_fmt='0.000', idx_label=None, widths=None):
    """Write a DataFrame with styled header. Returns next free row."""
    r0, c0 = start_row, start_col
    cols = ([idx_label or df.index.name or ''] if df.index.name is not None or idx_label else []) + list(df.columns)
    has_idx = len(cols) > len(df.columns)
    for j, cname in enumerate(cols):
        c = ws.cell(row=r0, column=c0+j, value=str(cname))
        c.fill = HDR_FILL; c.font = HDR_FONT; c.border = BORDER
        c.alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical='center', horizontal='center')
    for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(df.iterrows()):
        r = r0+1+i
        j = c0
        if has_idx:
            c = ws.cell(row=r, column=j, value=idx if not isinstance(idx, tuple) else str(idx))
            c.border = BORDER; j += 1
        for v in row:
            if isinstance(v, (np.integer,)): v = int(v)
            elif isinstance(v, (np.floating,)): v = None if pd.isna(v) else float(v)
            elif isinstance(v, float) and pd.isna(v): v = None
            c = ws.cell(row=r, column=j, value=v)
            c.border = BORDER
            if isinstance(v, float): c.number_format = num_fmt
            j += 1
    for j, cname in enumerate(cols):
        letter = get_column_letter(c0+j)
        if widths and cname in widths:
            ws.column_dimensions[letter].width = widths[cname]
        else:
            maxlen = max([len(str(cname))] + [len(str(x)) for x in df.iloc[:, j - (1 if has_idx else 0)] if j - (1 if has_idx else 0) < len(df.columns)]] or [8])
            ws.column_dimensions[letter].width = min(max(9, maxlen+2), 42)
    return r0+1+len(df)+1

def title(ws, text, sub=None, row=1):
    ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value=text).font = TITLE_FONT
    r = row+1
    if sub:
        c = ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=sub); c.font = NOTE_FONT
        r += 1
    return r+1

# ============ 00_README ============

ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
readme_rows = [
 ('T', '北新英格兰地区银行组合风险模型（假设性内部管理分析）'),

 ('N', '本工作簿为管理层提供佛蒙特(VT)、新罕布什尔(NH)、缅因(ME)三州54家FDIC保险银行的季度复核模型，评估期间2022-03-31至2025-06-30（14个季度）。本分析明确为假设性内部管理用途，基于给定数据快照的回顾分析，不构成对全国银行业的判断，不是分析期末当时可得信息的回测，也不构成投资建议或监管结论。'),
 ('S', '数据来源'),
 ('N', '1) fdic_financials_VT_NH_ME_2022_2025.csv —— FDIC BankFind Suite API 财务面板（746行 = 54家机构 × 最多14个季度），金额单位千美元；2) fdic_institutions_VT_NH_ME.csv —— FDIC 机构主数据（355个证书号，其中51家在营，用于机构对应、结构变化与业务特征）；3) financial_definitions.yaml / institution_definitions.yaml —— 字段官方定义；4) FDIC RMS Manual of Examination Policies §3.2 (Loans) 与 OCC Comptroller\'s Handbook "Rating Credit Risk" —— 非应计/分类/贷款审查的监管框架依据。'),
 ('S', '关键口径'),
 ('N', '· ROA/ROE/NIMY 为FDIC提供的年初至今(YTD)年化比率：Q2数值=上半年年化，季度间比较需注意年化窗口不同；· NTLNLS为当季净核销，模型中年化(×4)；· ELNATRY为YTD信用损失拨备/平均资产，未年化；· RBCRWAJ（总风险资本比率）为0视为"未申报"而非真实0（多为储蓄机构/互助控股架构），组合口径仅覆盖申报机构（期末37/52家，按资产覆盖78.95%）；· NCLNLSR=(非应计+90天以上逾期)/总贷款，已用原始字段复算验证一致；· 组合加权比率按期末总资产/贷款余额加权；"持续机构"(Continuing)=14个季度全样本的49家。'),

def q_label(q):
    return f"{q//10000}Q{(q%10000)//100:02d}"

def write_df(ws, df, start_row=1, start_col=1, num_fmt='0.000', idx_label=None, widths=None):
    """Write a DataFrame with styled header. Returns next free row."""
    r0, c0 = start_row, start_col
    cols = ([idx_label or df.index.name or ''] if df.index.name is not None or idx_label else []) + list(df.columns)
    has_idx = len(cols) > len(df.columns)
    for j, cname in enumerate(cols):
        c = ws.cell(row=r0, column=c0+j, value=str(cname))
        c.fill = HDR_FILL; c.font = HDR_FONT; c.border = BORDER
        c.alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical='center', horizontal='center')
    for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(df.iterrows()):
        r = r0+1+i
        j = c0
        if has_idx:
            c = ws.cell(row=r, column=j, value=idx if not isinstance(idx, tuple) else str(idx))
            c.border = BORDER; j += 1
        for v in row:
            if isinstance(v, (np.integer,)): v = int(v)
            elif isinstance(v, (np.floating,)): v = None if pd.isna(v) else float(v)
            elif isinstance(v, float) and pd.isna(v): v = None
            c = ws.cell(row=r, column=j, value=v)
            c.border = BORDER
            if isinstance(v, float): c.number_format = num_fmt
            j += 1
    for j, cname in enumerate(cols):
        letter = get_column_letter(c0+j)
        if widths and cname in widths:
            ws.column_dimensions[letter].width = widths[cname]
        else:
            dj = j - (1 if has_idx else 0)
            vals = [len(str(x)) for x in df.iloc[:, dj]] if 0 <= dj < len(df.columns) else []
            maxlen = max([len(str(cname))] + vals + [8])
            ws.column_dimensions[letter].width = min(max(9, maxlen+2), 42)
    return r0+1+len(df)+1

def title(ws, text, sub=None, row=1):
    ws.cell(row=row, column=1, value=text).font = TITLE_FONT
    r = row+1
    if sub:
        c = ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=sub); c.font = NOTE_FONT
        r += 1
    return r+1

#!/usr/bin/env python3

from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

ACCENT = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x4E, 0x79)

doc = Document()
# base style
st = doc.styles['Normal']
st.font.name = 'Calibri'; st.font.size = Pt(10.5)
st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'), '微软雅黑')
for i, (sz, sp) in enumerate([(16, 1), (13, 1), (11.5, 2)], start=1):
    h = doc.styles[f'Heading {i}']
    h.font.size = Pt(sz); h.font.color.rgb = ACCENT; h.font.bold = True
    h.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn('w:eastAsia'), '微软雅黑')

def P(text, bold=False, size=None, italic=False, color=None, style=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style=style)
    r = p.add_run(text)
    r.bold = bold; r.italic = italic
    if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    if color: r.font.color.rgb = color
    return p

def bullet(text, bold_prefix=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style='List Bullet')
    if bold_prefix:
        r = p.add_run(bold_prefix); r.bold = True
    p.add_run(text)
    return p

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    sh = OxmlElement('w:shd'); sh.set(qn('w:val'), 'clear'); sh.set(qn('w:fill'), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(sh)

def table(headers, rows, widths=None, fontsize=9, shade_rows=None):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers))
    t.style = 'Table Grid'; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for j, h in enumerate(headers):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[j]; c.text = ''
        r = c.paragraphs[0].add_run(h); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(fontsize)
        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
        shade(c, '1F4E79')
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for j, v in enumerate(row):
            cells[j].text = ''
            r = cells[j].paragraphs[0].add_run(str(v)); r.font.size = Pt(fontsize)
            if shade_rows and i in shade_rows:
                shade(cells[j], shade_rows[i] if isinstance(shade_rows, dict) else 'FFF3E0')
    if widths:
        for j, w in enumerate(widths):
            for row in t.rows:
                row.cells[j].width = Cm(w)
    return t

    return p

    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    sh = OxmlElement('w:shd'); sh.set(qn('w:val'), 'clear'); sh.set(qn('w:fill'), hexcolor)

    for j, h in enumerate(headers):
